lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hi! I'm Pip.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Everything you're watching right now was drawn by code, one frame at a time.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: It starts with a script: just the words I'm going to say.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: A voice reads it out, and we get the exact moment of every single word.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: So when I say pop, something pops.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: And when I say zoom, Bolt can zoom.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Change a line, and everything keyed to it moves right along with it.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: No dragging keyframes around by hand.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: And because it's all code, the camera can move, things can bounce, and my hair can do this.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Clapper can drive a web page, too.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Every click and every keystroke lands right on cue.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hit print, and it comes out in 3D.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I tear it off, and there's the label, ready to read.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Then I walk it over, on my own two feet.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I stick it on, and my scanner keeps up with every scan and every tap.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Scan the bin. Tilly pulls up: scan her,

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: tap Done, and she takes it from here.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: And when the video's done, one command puts it on YouTube.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: That's Clapper.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Words in, video out.
